title: Patch: the deck builder splits on a 744-pixel iPad mini and keeps deck names readable; the collection's set progress row shows it scrolls
thread:
**Issue #3956 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3956: Patch: the deck builder splits on a 744-pixel iPad mini and keeps deck names readable; the collection's set progress row shows it scrolls
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

A follow-up to the collection and deck builder (#3734, merged in #3775), found in its device-size screenshots. Part of the tracker #3726.

### What happens

- **Deck builder, iPad mini portrait 744×1133:** the deck sits above the pool behind "Show list", not side by side, though #3775 says the editor splits from 601 px. It does split at 820×1180. ([744 shot](`` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/89d964e0dc1ba0824859c9a872cf3c54aee47285/3734-collection/deckbuilder-744x1133-ipad-mini-portrait.png), `` [820 shot](``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/89d964e0dc1ba0824859c9a872cf3c54aee47285/3734-collection/deckbuilder-820x1180-ipad-portrait.png ```))
- **Deck builder, 820 and 744:** the deck rail cuts names to four letters ("Pyre…", "Tide …", "Quic…"). The "Decks" title sits on its own row above Back instead of beside it.
- **Deck builder, phone 390×844:** the deck name field shows "Pyre Contro", cut. ([shot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/89d964e0dc1ba0824859c9a872cf3c54aee47285/3734-collection/deckbuilder-390x844-phone.png))
- **Deck builder, desktop 1280×720:** the editor's last action row is cut at the window's bottom and scrolls inside the column.
- **Cards tab:** the per-set progress row cuts set names ("Stinkysc…", "Training Gr…") at 1440, 1366 and 1280, and runs off the right edge at every size with nothing to show it scrolls. ([shot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/89d964e0dc1ba0824859c9a872cf3c54aee47285/3734-collection/cards-1280x720-desktop.png))

All shots: https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/pull/3775#issuecomment-6892224130.

### What should happen

At every device size in #3726: the deck builder splits deck and pool side by side on both upright iPads (744 and 820), as #3775 meant. The rail shows each deck's name in full, or wrapped onto two lines, not cut to a few letters. The title sits beside Back. The name field shows the whole name on a phone. The editor's actions are in view at 1280×720. The set progress row shows its names in full, or wraps, or scrolls with a visible cue.

### Where

`apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckWorkshop.tsx`, `WorkshopFrame.tsx`, `DeckSidebar.tsx`, `DeckEditor.tsx`, `deckbuilder.css`; the progress row in `apps/web/src/collection/` (`OwnedCards.tsx`, `collection.css`).

### Tests

Checks that fail without the fix, in the spec that renders the deck builder at `MENU_SIZES`: at 744×1133 the deck list and the pool are both visible side by side; at 820 and 744 a deck's full name is shown in the rail (no ellipsis on a name of at most 14 characters). Keep the existing deck-builder and collection tests passing.

I'll take the device-size screenshots for the pull request once it merges.
````
